# g03 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 10
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 1 for i = 1, ..., 10

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = - \sqrt{10} \sum_{i=1}^{10} x_i \left(1 + \cos\left(\frac{i \pi}{2} x_i\right)\right)
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{10} x_i^2 - 1 \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -1.000500
